name: Laurent Nuñez
party: Renaissance (no formal party membership before government; career senior civil servant)
bio: Laurent Marie Joseph Nuñez (born 19 February 1964 in Bourges) is a French senior civil servant and prefect who became Minister of the Interior on 12 October 2025 in the second government of Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu, succeeding Bruno Retailleau. He retained the post in the February 2026 reshuffle. A career prefectoral and intelligence official rather than an elected politician, he previously served as Director-General of Internal Security (DGSI, 2017-2018), Secretary of State to the Minister of the Interior (2018-2020), head of the National Centre for Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism (CNRLT, 2020-2022) and Prefect of Police of Paris (2022-2025). Of Spanish descent, he studied public management at the University of Tours and graduated from the École nationale d'administration in 1999. As Interior Minister he has made the fight against drug trafficking and 'everyday security' his stated priorities.
